landing_code_sample_heading: Drop identity into your app with focused SDKs
landing_code_sample_subheading: Use framework adapters while GateKeeper handles sessions, OAuth redirects, and secure API calls.

landing_features_heading: Everything your application needs to manage identity
landing_features_mfa_description: Support authenticator apps, email codes, and passkeys for stronger sign-in flows.

landing_hero_no_credit_card: Start locally. No credit card required.
